reply_text:
Found four issues before merge:

1. **P1 — Short previews lose text and always get an ellipsis** — `src/excerpt.js:6–8`  
   `excerpt('hello world', 20)` returns `"hello…"`, and empty input returns `"…"`. This violates the documented unchanged-at-or-under-limit behavior.  
   **Fix:** Return the input unchanged when its length is within the limit; only find a cut and append an ellipsis for longer text.

2. **P1 — The helpers aren’t connected to cards** — `src/card.js:2`  
   `card()` still returns the full, trimmed body. Neither `toPlain()` nor `excerpt()` has a production caller, so this branch doesn’t actually change card previews.  
   **Fix:** Wire markdown flattening and excerpting into the card-body path, with an integration test.

3. **P2 — A word ending exactly at the limit is dropped** — `src/words.js:2–3`  
   `excerpt('one two three', 7)` returns `"one…"` instead of `"one two…"`. The slice excludes the space at index 7, so the helper backs up unnecessarily.  
   **Fix:** Include the boundary at `limit` in the search. Update `test/words.test.js`, which currently asserts the incorrect result.

4. **P2 — Markdown stripping deletes meaningful characters** — `src/plain.js:3`  
   Global marker deletion turns ``Use `snake_case` here`` into `"Use snakecase here"` and `[API_docs](https://example.com)` into `"APIdocs"`. These underscores are content, not formatting.  
   **Fix:** Strip markdown structurally, preserving literal characters in code and link text.

All four existing tests pass; the reproductions above expose cases they miss. **No files changed.**
